decision: Extend existing CMB index, codec and profile/output orchestration; two responsibility-specific functions are necessary rather than appending unrelated algorithms to existing functions. No new per-patch handler, CLI, writer, texture parser or image codec.
Serena: Current authorTexture sole production caller run; cmbIndex sole production caller planBundle; texture shared authorTexture and self-readback; inspect consumers ELF/planning/fit/audit; generatePalette texture only. Source bodies and docs inspected.

existing_candidates.cmbIndex: Enhance to also return original member-name order alongside exact name->span map; change planBundle caller to ignore ordered slice. Do not duplicate CMB parser or sort by payload offsets.
existing_candidates.authorTexture: Continue owning profile, operation refusal and dispatch/publication. Existing selected-TXD orchestration is already ~370lines; adding full streaming archive traversal, PNG exports and per-entry status rows would mix two distinct lifecycles. Enhance dispatch to manifestTextures without moving historical single-asset behavior.
existing_candidates.texture/indexTextures: Retain sole structural/layout/pixel parser and decoder; batch calls these. They cannot reasonably own archive entries, metadata-only blobs, annotation joins or sheet manifests.
existing_candidates.generatePalette: Mutates/normalizes alpha and transparent RGB and quantizes; source discovery measures original pixels without mutation. Enhancing with a reporting mode would couple incompatible contracts.
existing_candidates.composeCells/renderRuns/resizeRaster: Paint/compose/resample; discovery classifies unchanged pixels. No sensible enhancement owns a tile detector.
existing_candidates.inspect: ELF mappings/text readiness and edits; a raster detector mode would couple unrelated binary and image domains.
existing_candidates.writeNewFile: Retain sole exclusive publication with digest/readback; publish one deterministic ZIP containing previews and manifest, not a partial multi-file directory.

unavoidable_functions.inspectRaster: Pure unchanged-pixel measurements and discovery classification, reusable by manifest and later preview/contact consumers. Accept explicit nil/unmeasurable raster, retain path tier and unknown stats; no OCR or approval.
unavoidable_functions.manifestTextures: Streaming extracted-CMB traversal and bounded preview bundle assembly. Reuses cmbIndex order, indexTextures, texture, inspectRaster and writeNewFile. Full source hashing before/after; every entry accounted including empty/nontexture/unsupported, duplicate native names, invalid PNG/TXD; ambiguous authored joins refuse publication.

source_errors: Original <8 returns erroneous 3tuple; cropped nonmultiple8 mask throws. New domain explicitly reports unavailable with null score, preserves reason diagnostics and path/name evidence. No claim of legacy6counter parity outside successful multiple8 domain.
bounds: Extracted CMB regular <=1GiB streamed, <=100000 index records and <=100000 total raster rows. Individual asset decode <=64MiB and <=1Mpx. Total potential attempted decode pixels <=2^28 (including failed attempts), with explicit row budget status; no entry truncation. Single deterministic contained ZIP<=128MiB, over-limit publication globally refuses. Profile1MiB; JSON strict owned scalar contracts. No ISO reads.
effects: Legacy inventory/specification/default outputs/refusals unchanged; new manifest requires explicit source/index pins and archive label. Apply produces only exclusive new ZIP, dry-run none. Source/profile guarded through complete batch; no canonical/protected runtime operations.
affected: accounting/coverage/proof/roadmap after focused checks and independent review
claim: New capability growth, not code reduction/retirement. .04 remains open until complete source-backed contract verified.
source_name_domain: Manifest requires UTF-8 member names, without changing existing CMB planner name semantics. Independent header-only crawl of6extracted CMB indexes found0non-UTF8 names among4201entries; no whole-source hash/codec completion claim from this crawl.
